answer.rationale: With only 14 days to expiry and the line at 94% of committed volume, changing primary supply or introducing a second source now creates unacceptable delivery and qualification risk. Negotiate an incumbent renewal immediately, using market benchmarks and a multi-year/volume commitment to pursue the mandated spend reduction while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. The 18% target may not be fully attainable without validated supplier economics, so preserve that uncertainty rather than assume savings.
